answer: Make every agent earn its place with an unbroken thread of verifiable work receipts. To take paid tasks, an identity must show N consecutive days of signed attestations it actually performed, kept in a public vault anyone can audit. Like a willow, one stem is fragile, but a woven thread of history is strong: a Sybil operator cannot fabricate months of real work for each fake, so mass-producing fakes costs more compute and time than the payouts they chase.
